text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Victory in the Japanese Derby, the second 
leg of the Classic Triple Crown. Seiun 
Sky's grandfather, who had secretly come 
to cheer in person, is overjoyed as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though tears were shed after failing to 
achieve her greatest dream—winning the 
Derby—Special Week quickly looked ahead 
once more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky is deeply impressed by her 
strength. The contest moves onward to the 
final leg of the Classic Triple Crown: the 
Kikuka Sho—
